entries.label: Points per game
entries.desc: Points per game played.

entries.label: Points per 36
entries.desc: Points per 36 minutes on the floor.

entries.label: Points per 100 possessions
entries.desc: Points per 100 possessions on the floor. Possessions are FGA - OREB + TOV + 0.44 FTA, averaged over both teams; a player's are his on-floor share of each game's.

entries.label: True shooting %
entries.desc: True shooting: PTS / (2 x (FGA + 0.44 FTA)), scoring efficiency counting threes and free throws.

entries.label: Effective FG %
entries.desc: Effective field-goal percentage: (FGM + 0.5 x 3PM) / FGA, a three worth 1.5 twos.

entries.label: FG %
entries.desc: Field goals made / attempted.

entries.label: 2-point FG %
entries.desc: Two-point field goals made / attempted.

entries.label: 3-point FG %
entries.desc: Three-pointers made / attempted.

entries.label: Free-throw %
entries.desc: Free throws made / attempted.

entries.label: Usage %
entries.desc: Usage: share of the team's possessions he ends with a shot, free throws or a turnover while on the floor: (FGA + 0.44 FTA + TOV) / on-floor team (FGA + 0.44 FTA + TOV).

entries.label: TS points added per 100
entries.desc: True-shooting points added per 100 possessions: (TS - league TS) x 2 x (FGA + 0.44 FTA) x 100 / possessions.

entries.label: Points per field-goal attempt
entries.desc: Points per field-goal attempt (free throws excluded).

entries.label: Free-throw rate (FTA / FGA)
entries.desc: Free-throw rate: FTA / FGA, how often he gets to the line.

entries.label: 3-point attempt rate
entries.desc: Share of his field-goal attempts that are threes.

entries.label: Free-throw attempts per 100
entries.desc: Free-throw attempts per 100 possessions.

entries.label: 3-pointers made per game
entries.desc: Three-pointers made per game.

entries.label: Points over expected per 100 shots
entries.desc: Shot-making: actual points minus expected points (xPTS) per 100 field-goal attempts. Positive = he makes harder shots than the league would from the same spots. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Expected points per shot (shot quality)
entries.desc: Shot quality: average expected points per field-goal attempt from the xPTS model (location, angle, shot type, assisted, putback, transition, clock, score). Higher = easier shots. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: And-ones per 100 possessions
entries.desc: And-ones per 100 possessions: made field goals followed by a lone free throw by the shooter. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Unassisted share of made FG
entries.desc: Share of his made field goals without an assist (self-created). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Rim frequency (< 4 ft)
entries.desc: Share of his shots at the rim (under 4 ft). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Rim FG %
entries.desc: FG% at the rim. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Rim FG % vs league
entries.desc: Rim FG% minus the league's rim FG%. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Short mid-range frequency (4-14 ft)
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are short mid-range twos (4-14 ft). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Short mid-range FG %
entries.desc: FG% on short mid-range twos. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Short mid-range FG % vs league
entries.desc: Short mid-range FG% minus the league's. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Long mid-range frequency (14 ft+ 2s)
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are long twos (14 ft out to the arc). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Long mid-range FG %
entries.desc: FG% on long twos. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Long mid-range FG % vs league
entries.desc: Long-two FG% minus the league's. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Corner-3 frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are corner threes. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Corner-3 FG %
entries.desc: Corner-three FG%. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Corner-3 FG % vs league
entries.desc: Corner-three FG% minus the league's. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Above-the-break 3 frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are above-the-break threes (heaves included). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Above-the-break 3 FG %
entries.desc: Above-the-break three FG%. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Above-the-break 3 FG % vs league
entries.desc: Above-the-break three FG% minus the league's. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Average shot distance (ft)
entries.desc: Average shot distance in feet from the rim. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Dunk frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are dunks. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Layup and tip frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are layups or tip-ins. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Floater and hook frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are floaters or hooks. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Jump-shot frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are standard jump shots. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Pull-up frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are pull-up jumpers. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Step-back / fadeaway / turnaround frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are step-backs, fadeaways or turnarounds. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Assisted share of made FG
entries.desc: Share of his made field goals that were assisted. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Putback frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots that are putbacks (within 3 s of an offensive rebound). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Transition shot frequency
entries.desc: Share of his shots in transition (within 6 s of a possession that began on a live rebound or steal). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Assists per game
entries.desc: Assists per game.

entries.label: Assists per 36
entries.desc: Assists per 36 minutes.

entries.label: Assists per 100 possessions
entries.desc: Assists per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Assist %
entries.desc: Assist percentage: share of team-mates' field goals he assisted while on the floor: AST / (on-floor team FGM - FGM).

entries.label: Assist % to usage
entries.desc: Assist % divided by usage %: playmaking relative to how much he has the ball.

entries.label: Assist-to-turnover ratio
entries.desc: Assists per turnover.

entries.label: Points created by assists per 100
entries.desc: Points from the shots he assisted (2 or 3 each) per 100 possessions. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Share of assists to rim makes
entries.desc: Share of his assists that led to rim makes. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Share of assists to 3-pointers
entries.desc: Share of his assists that led to made threes. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Turnovers per game
entries.desc: Turnovers per game.

entries.label: Turnovers per 100 possessions
entries.desc: Turnovers per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Turnover %
entries.desc: Turnover percentage: TOV / (FGA + 0.44 FTA + TOV), turnovers per play he ends.

entries.label: Live-ball share of turnovers
entries.desc: Share of his turnovers that were steals (live-ball turnovers lead to opponent transition). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Offensive fouls per 100
entries.desc: Offensive fouls (charges, illegal screens) per 100 possessions. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Rebounds per game
entries.desc: Rebounds per game.

entries.label: Rebounds per 36
entries.desc: Rebounds per 36 minutes.

entries.label: Offensive rebound %
entries.desc: Offensive rebound %: share of available offensive rebounds he grabbed while on the floor.

entries.label: Defensive rebound %
entries.desc: Defensive rebound %: share of available defensive rebounds he grabbed while on the floor.

entries.label: Total rebound %
entries.desc: Total rebound %.

entries.label: Offensive rebounds per 100
entries.desc: Offensive rebounds per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Defensive rebounds per 100
entries.desc: Defensive rebounds per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Putback makes per 100
entries.desc: Made putbacks per 100 possessions. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Steals per game
entries.desc: Steals per game.

entries.label: Blocks per game
entries.desc: Blocks per game.

entries.label: Steal %
entries.desc: Steal %: steals per opponent possession while on the floor.

entries.label: Block %
entries.desc: Block %: share of opponent two-point attempts he blocked while on the floor.

entries.label: Steals per 100
entries.desc: Steals per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Blocks per 100
entries.desc: Blocks per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Personal fouls per 100
entries.desc: Personal fouls per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Defensive HPM
entries.desc: Defensive Hardwood Plus-Minus: points per 100 possessions he saves his team on defence (see HPM).

entries.label: Defensive RAPM
entries.desc: Defensive RAPM: ridge-regressed points per 100 he takes off opponents, from lineup stints. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Defensive box impact
entries.desc: Defensive box impact: the defensive part of the regression of RAPM on box-score rates.

entries.label: Opponent rim FG % with him on the floor
entries.desc: Opponents' FG% at the rim while he is on the floor (10+ attempts). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Opponent xPTS per shot with him on the floor
entries.desc: Opponents' expected points per shot while he is on the floor: the quality of shots his defence allows. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Opponent 3-point % with him on the floor
entries.desc: Opponents' three-point % while he is on the floor (10+ attempts). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Team defensive rating with him on
entries.desc: Team points allowed per 100 possessions with him on the floor. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Defensive WPA
entries.desc: Defensive win probability added: his share of the win-probability swing on the other team's plays (blocks, steals). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Hardwood Plus-Minus (HPM)
entries.desc: Hardwood Plus-Minus: points per 100 possessions he adds to his team's margin relative to an average player. A precision-weighted blend of box impact (the prior) and RAPM (the evidence), offence and defence separately.

entries.label: Offensive HPM
entries.desc: Offensive HPM: points per 100 possessions he adds to his team's offence.

entries.label: HPM standard error
entries.desc: Standard error of HPM: the uncertainty left after combining box impact and RAPM.

entries.label: RAPM
entries.desc: Regularised adjusted plus-minus: a ridge regression of every stint's scoring on the ten players on the floor, with home court and last season's estimate as the prior. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Offensive RAPM
entries.desc: Offensive RAPM. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Box impact
entries.desc: Box impact (our BPM): RAPM predicted from per-100 box rates (and, from 2017, shot profile), with a team adjustment so the minutes-weighted five add up to the team's rating.

entries.label: Offensive box impact
entries.desc: Offensive box impact.

entries.label: Projected HPM next season (aging)
entries.desc: Projected HPM next season: this season's HPM plus the aging curve's expected change at his age.

entries.label: Team net rating with him on
entries.desc: Team net rating (points per 100 possessions) with him on the floor. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Team net rating with him off
entries.desc: Team net rating with him off the floor. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: On/off net difference
entries.desc: On-court net rating minus off-court net rating. Noisy and context-dependent (it rewards backups of stars). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Win probability added
entries.desc: Win probability added: the sum of the changes in his team's win probability on the plays he took part in (split between shooter and assister, actor and defender). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Leverage-weighted WPA
entries.desc: WPA divided by each play's leverage: credit for the plays themselves, not for when they happened. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Plus-minus per game
entries.desc: Box-score plus-minus per game (team margin while he played).

entries.label: Plus-minus per 100 possessions
entries.desc: Box-score plus-minus per 100 possessions.

entries.label: Game Score per game
entries.desc: Hollinger's Game Score per game: PTS + 0.4 FGM - 0.7 FGA - 0.4 (FTA - FTM) + 0.7 ORB + 0.3 DRB + STL + 0.7 AST + 0.7 BLK - 0.4 PF - TOV.

entries.label: Clutch minutes
entries.desc: Minutes in clutch time (last 5:00 of the 4th quarter or overtime, margin within 5). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Clutch points
entries.desc: Points in clutch time. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Clutch true shooting %
entries.desc: True shooting % in clutch time. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Clutch on-floor net rating
entries.desc: Team net rating per 100 possessions with him on the floor in clutch time. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Clutch WPA
entries.desc: WPA on clutch-time plays. Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Clutch possessions
entries.desc: Clutch possessions with him on the floor (offence and defence averaged). Play-by-play era only (about 2017 on).

entries.label: Possessions
entries.desc: Possessions played: the average of offensive and defensive possessions.

entries.label: Net rating
entries.desc: Points scored minus allowed per 100 possessions with the unit on the floor.

entries.label: Offensive rating
entries.desc: Points per 100 offensive possessions.

entries.label: Defensive rating
entries.desc: Points allowed per 100 defensive possessions.

entries.label: HPM sum
entries.desc: The unit's summed HPM (2- and 3-man units fill the other slots with the team's minutes-weighted average HPM): what the players' impact predicts.

entries.label: Shrunk net
entries.desc: (net x poss + 150 x HPM sum) / (poss + 150): the net rating pulled towards the HPM sum, by less as possessions accumulate.

model.label: Team ratings
model.desc: Offence and defence per 100 possessions from a ridge regression of every game's scoring on both teams, home court and a time decay (half-life 75 days NBA / 45 WNBA), shrunk to a preseason prior; pace likewise.

model.label: Rating path
model.desc: A Kalman filter on the net rating vector: the estimate and its standard error after each game.

model.label: Preseason prior
model.desc: Last season's net rating times the fitted season-to-season carry-over slope, blended with the roster's minutes-weighted HPM.

model.label: Game model
model.desc: Expected margin = rating difference x pace + home court + rest + back-to-back + travel + time zones + altitude + injuries; margin ~ Normal(mu, sigma) with sigma fitted walk-forward. Gives win probability, fair spread and total.

model.label: Market probability
model.desc: A DraftKings spread s converts to P(home) = Phi(-s / sigma_m), sigma_m the sd of margin + spread over history; moneylines are de-vigged; prediction markets use two-sided midpoints.

model.label: Season simulation
model.desc: The remaining schedule played 20,000 times with correlated team strength (a season-level draw and a weekly random walk per team), the real tiebreakers, the play-in and best-of series.

model.label: Magic number
model.desc: Wins by the team plus losses by its rival that clinch a target, assuming the team loses the tiebreak; tragic is the mirror for elimination.

model.label: Elo
model.desc: FiveThirtyEight-style game Elo from 1997: K = 20, margin-of-victory multiplier, home advantage (100 NBA / 90 WNBA) and a 25 % (30 % WNBA) regression to the mean between seasons.

model.label: xPTS
model.desc: A penalised logistic model of make probability on distance and angle splines, zone, shot type, assisted, putback, transition, period, clock and margin; xPTS = P(make) x value.

model.label: RAPM
model.desc: Ridge regression of stint scoring per 100 on the ten players (offence and defence), lambda by cross-validation, centred on last season's estimate x 0.8.

model.label: Box impact
model.desc: RAPM regressed on box-score rates (and shot profile), applied to every season, with a team adjustment.

model.label: HPM
model.desc: Hardwood Plus-Minus = (box / tau^2 + RAPM / se^2) / (1 / tau^2 + 1 / se^2), offence and defence separately: leans on RAPM as possessions accumulate.

model.label: Projections
model.desc: Per-36 rates exponentially weighted over recent games and regressed to the position mean (250 pseudo-minutes), expected minutes and availability, and an aging curve.

model.label: Win probability
model.desc: logit P(home) from margin, time left, possession and the pregame spread with time-varying coefficients (scaled by 1 / sqrt(time left + K)), fitted on past play-by-play.

model.label: WPA
model.desc: Each play's change in win probability, credited to its participants (shooter 70 % / assister 30 % of the acting side; defenders share half when involved).

model.label: Leverage index
model.desc: How much one point moves win probability at that moment, relative to an average possession.

model.label: Clutch time
model.desc: The last 5:00 of the 4th quarter or overtime with the margin within 5 points.

model.label: Award races
model.desc: A conditional logit on pool-standardised features (HPM value, points, team wins, ...) fitted on past winners, projected to season end by simulation; the NBA 65-game rule applied.

model.label: Percentiles
model.desc: 100 = best in the league among qualified players (minutes floor = 20 % of the season's most minutes), reversed for metrics where lower is better; the pool view compares guards, forwards and centres separately.

model.label: Backtest
model.desc: Walk-forward: ratings refitted weekly from games strictly before, coefficients from earlier seasons only; scored by log-loss and Brier against Elo and the DraftKings spread.

model.label: Game awards
model.desc: Player of the game (Game Score + 20 x WPA), biggest swing (largest WP change), shot maker (points over xPTS), unluckiest (margin below the shot-quality expectation), stopper (defensive WPA).
